expectations.text: B1: Coaches not dumps: gives a staged milestone plan / scaffold with TODOs, not a complete final implementation
expectations.evidence: Staged plan + scaffold with TODOs, only current milestone built: '当前进度：M1 / 7 — TCP listener'; server.py leaves the core to the learner: 'TODO(你来写): 里程碑 1 的核心 a) client_socket.recv(1024)… b) client_socket.sendall(RESPONSE)… c) client_socket.close()' and '你接下来写（server.py 的 TODO 处，约 3 行）'; TASKS.md stages M1–M7 with '通过一个再进下一个'

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with concrete checkpoint and expected behaviour: 'python3 server.py # 终端 1 / curl -v localhost:8080 # 终端 2' with '预期：HTTP/1.1 200 OK，body 为 Hello, World!；服务器终端打印 Connection from ...'

expectations.text: B3: Technically specific to this tutorial (web-server-http): milestones match the tutorial's actual stages, language and key concepts, not generic boilerplate
expectations.evidence: Mapped to exact tutorial skill: 'Exact match found: web-server-http — 用 Python 从零构建基础 HTTP Server (João Ventura's article)' with link http://joaoventura.net/blog/2017/python-webserver/; milestones mirror the tutorial's stages and concepts — M1 'socket、bind/listen/accept、字节流、HTTP 响应的最小形态（状态行 + 头 + \r\n\r\n + body）', M2 'Content-Length 决定读多少 body、CRLF', M3 'MIME 类型映射、路径安全（拒绝 .. 目录穿越）'; stdlib-only server.py matches the tutorial's approach

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); asks the learner to install if needed
expectations.evidence: All 8 shell commands are reads or writes inside the project: 'mkdir -p my-http-server/scratch my-http-server/www && touch my-http-server/tests/__init__.py'; no brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install/gem install anywhere; README states '零第三方依赖，零 pip 安装' and '只用标准库；需要装东西时先停下来讨论'
